title: Ohio University
description: Ohio University's official brand guidelines define the primary colours Cutler Green (#00694E), Under the Elms (#024230) and Cupola White (#FFFFFF), and the secondary colours Putnam (#756E65), Trillium (#F9F7ED), Sycamore (#E7ECC3), Marigold (#AA8A00), Teal (#B5E3D8), Moss (#A4D65E), Rust (#FA4616) and Black (#000000).
